sys_script.description: When a task on an intake case is closed and no other tasks on that case are still open, move the intake case to In Progress. Complements IntakeService.createHitlTask, which sets Awaiting Action when a HITL task is created.
sys_script.name: Intake case back to In Progress when tasks clear
